originalTitle: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?
title: Great News! Africa's Biggest Football Party Stays Every Two Years!
content:
Hello, my amazing football friends from all over Africa! I'm your special kid-friendly news reporter, and I have some super exciting news for all of you who love kicking a ball and cheering for your favourite teams! Get ready, because it's all about our beloved Africa Cup of Nations!

A Big Football Party! What is AFCON?

Imagine a giant party where all the best football teams from different countries in Africa come together! That’s what the Africa Cup of Nations, or AFCON for short, is all about! It’s like the biggest, most exciting football tournament for our continent. Teams play amazing matches, and everyone cheers really loudly! It’s full of colourful jerseys, happy songs, and incredible goals! Players like Mohamed Salah, Sadio Mané, and Victor Osimhen all play in AFCON. They are like superheroes on the field! Did you know? The Africa Cup of Nations is one of the oldest football tournaments in the world! It started a very, very long time ago, even before your parents were born! That makes it extra special. It's not just about football; it's about friendship, showing off our amazing talent, and celebrating Africa together!

How Often Do We Play?

Now, imagine you really, really love a special treat, like your favourite cake. How often would you want to have it? Every day? Every week? For a long, long time, we have been lucky enough to have this giant football party, AFCON, every two years! That means every two years, we get to watch our teams play, cheer for our heroes, and dream of winning the big trophy. It's like having a big birthday party for football every other year! Two years is not too long to wait for such a big celebration, right?

Guess What? It's Staying!

Hold onto your football socks, because here is the super news! The Africa Cup of Nations will keep happening every two years! Yay! This means more exciting football matches, more chances to see our favourite players, and more reasons to jump up and down with joy! The grown-ups who organize everything have decided that keeping it every two years is the best thing for all of us football fans and for the players too. So, get ready to keep your cheering voices strong!

What Was the Big Talk About?

You know how sometimes grown-ups talk about changing things? Well, a little while ago, the people who organize AFCON, they thought about changing how often we have the tournament. They were thinking, maybe we could have it every *four* years instead of two. Like going from having a party every two years to having it every four years. That would mean waiting a much longer time between each football celebration! Imagine waiting four whole years to see your favourite team play in AFCON! That's a long, long time, isn't it? But then, they had another big talk, and they listened to what many people thought. And guess what? They changed their minds! They decided, 'No, let's keep it every two years!' This is what we call a 'U-turn' – like when a car turns around and goes back the way it came. They went back to the original plan, and that's super good news for us!

Why Keep It Every Two Years?

Why is it better to have AFCON every two years? Well, there are many good reasons! 1. **More Football Fun!** We get to watch more amazing football! More games, more goals, more saves, more fantastic moments to remember! Who doesn't love more football? 2. **More Chances for Our Heroes!** For the players, it means they get more chances to show off their skills and win the big trophy for their country. If it was every four years, some players might get older and miss their chance. Every two years means more opportunities for all the talented footballers in Africa! 3. **More Excitement!** The excitement builds up so quickly when it's just two years away. Every two years, we get to feel that amazing buzz, see our countries come alive with flags and songs, and watch the whole continent celebrate. 4. **Helps Our Teams Grow!** Playing in big tournaments like AFCON helps our national teams get stronger and better. More tournaments mean more chances to learn and improve. Did you know? Hosting AFCON is a huge honour! Different African countries get to host the tournament. When a country hosts, it means they get to welcome all the teams and fans, build beautiful stadiums, and show off their amazing culture to the whole world!

Who Makes These Big Decisions?

You might be wondering, 'Who are these grown-ups who decide all these important things about AFCON?' Well, there's a very important group called CAF. It stands for the 'Confederation of African Football.' Think of CAF as the grown-up 'boss' or the main organizer for all the big football games and tournaments in Africa. They make sure everything is fair, exciting, and runs smoothly. So, when we say 'CAF decided,' it means the main organizers of African football made this happy decision!

What This Means For You!

So, my dear football fans, what does this big news mean for you? It means you can keep dreaming of watching your favourite team play in AFCON sooner rather than later! You can keep practicing your own football skills, hoping that one day you might be one of those heroes on the field! It means more shared moments with your family and friends, cheering loudly for your country. AFCON is more than just a game; it brings us all together. It shows how strong, talented, and joyful Africa is. So, let’s get ready to celebrate our next AFCON, knowing that another one will come along in just two years! Keep loving football, keep playing, and keep cheering!
summary: The Africa Cup of Nations, a big football tournament for Africa, will continue to be held every two years, making sure fans and players get more chances to celebrate and play.
whyMatters: This is important because it means we get to see our favourite African teams play in a huge tournament more often, bringing more joy and excitement to kids and families across Africa.

originalTitle: US appeals court again rejects Trump bid to set aside California ballots
title: Big Judges Say No to Taking Away Votes!
content:
Hello, super kids! It's your friendly news reporter for Africa, ready to share some exciting news from far, far away! Today, we're talking about something super important that happened in a country called America. It's all about making sure everyone's voice counts, just like in your classroom or your community!

What Happened in America?

Imagine you are playing a big game with all your friends. Everyone gets a chance to score points. Then, when it's time to count all the scores, someone says, "Wait! Don't count *those* scores! Take away 20,000 of them!" What would you think? A bit unfair, right? You'd want every single score to be counted! Well, something a little bit like that happened in America. Grown-ups there were choosing their leaders. This is called voting. They use special papers called ballots to show who they want to be their leader. Someone wanted to take away 20,000 of these voting papers from a very big part of America called California. They wanted these votes to disappear, just like magic! But that would mean 20,000 people's choices wouldn't be heard.

The Super Judges Say NO!

Luckily, in America, they have very special teams of judges. These judges are like super-smart referees for the country's rules. They make sure everything is fair and follows the law. A special team of these big judges, called the 9th Circuit Court, looked at this situation very carefully. They studied all the rules, just like you might study for a test. And what did they say? They said a very big, clear, "NO!" They said, "You cannot take away those 20,000 voting papers!" They told everyone that trying to remove those votes was against the country's most important rule book. They used a big word: "unconstitutional." Don't worry, we'll explain what that means!

What is Voting?

Did you know? Voting is how grown-ups choose their leaders! It's how people decide who will help run their country, make important decisions, and keep everyone safe and happy. It's like picking a team captain, but for a whole country! When people vote, they usually put a mark on a paper or press a button to show who they want. Every grown-up gets one vote, and every vote is important. It's how everyone gets a say in who leads them. Here in Africa, we also have elections where people vote for their leaders. It's a way for everyone's voice to be heard and for the people to choose who they trust to lead them.

The Big Rule Book (Constitution)!

Did you know? Every country has a special set of rules, just like your school or your home has rules! These are not just any rules; they are the most important rules for the whole country. In America, these super-important rules are written down in a very special book called the Constitution. This book tells everyone what they can and cannot do. It makes sure things are fair for everyone and that the government does things the right way. So, when the judges said that taking away the votes was "unconstitutional," it means it was against the rules written in that big, special rule book! It's like trying to play football with your hands when the rules clearly say "no hands!" The judges were just making sure everyone followed the country's important game rules.

Why Are Judges So Important?

Did you know? Judges are like super-smart referees for a country's rules! Judges don't make the rules themselves, but they make sure everyone follows the rules, especially the ones in the big rule book. When people disagree about something important, like whether votes should be counted, the judges listen to everyone. They look at the rules very carefully and then make a decision. Their job is to make sure that everything is fair and that the country's laws are always followed. This helps everyone trust that things are done properly and that no one can just change the rules to suit themselves.

California: A Very Big Place!

Did you know? California is one of the biggest states in America, with millions and millions of people living there! It's so big, it's like a whole country itself! The votes that someone wanted to take away were from this huge place. So, even though it was "only" 20,000 votes, that's still a lot of people's voices. Imagine 20,000 kids all trying to say something important, and then someone says, "No, don't listen to them!" That wouldn't be right!

Why Does This Matter to YOU?

Did you know? When everyone's vote is counted fairly, it means that the leaders chosen are truly the ones the people want! This story is important because it reminds us that rules are there for a reason: to keep things fair for everyone. Whether it's in America, or right here in Africa, or anywhere else in the world, it's super important that when people vote, every single vote is counted fairly. When judges say "no" to unfair things, it helps make sure that every person's voice is heard. It means that what you think, and what the grown-ups in your family think, truly matters. This helps a country stay strong and fair, because everyone knows that the rules will be followed, and their choices will be respected. It's like knowing that in your favourite game, the scorekeeper will always count everyone's points correctly! So, my wonderful kids, remember this story from America. It teaches us that rules are there to keep things fair, and that every single voice, every single vote, is important. Keep learning and asking questions about how things work in your country and around the world! Until next time, stay curious and remember: your voice matters!
summary: Big judges in America said "No!" to someone who wanted to take away 20,000 voting papers, saying it was against the country's important rules to ensure fairness for everyone's voice.
whyMatters: This matters because it shows that rules are very important to keep things fair in a country, and that every single vote and every person's voice should be counted and respected when choosing leaders.
